# The Technological Bluff

*[Jacques Ellul](../philosophers/ellul.md) · 1988*

The last part of [Ellul](../philosophers/ellul.md)'s trilogy: he denounces the discourse that surrounds technology, advertising, promises and forecasting, which masks its costs, its risks and its unpredictability.
